control_amendment: The v1 primary method concatenated cross-fitted predicted UTS, whereas its shuffled comparison used a residual-anchor architecture. V2 retains the primary method, data, split, budgets, learners, seeds and inference unchanged, and adds the architecture-matched control obtained by concatenating a fold-wise shuffled-UTS prediction.
selection_basis: The planned-state, cross-fitted predicted-UTS concatenation candidate was selected after the local method-development screen. No architecture may replace it in this run.
research_question: Is the selected state-matched UTS borrowing procedure stable across many target-label draws and two declared tree learners when predicting chemically held-out MPEA yield strength, and does it beat an architecture-matched shuffled donor?
claim_guard: Because MPEA outcomes were inspected during method selection and v1 verification exposed the control-architecture mismatch, this is a post-selection robustness and control-correction run, not an independent confirmation. V2 can validate source specificity on this programme but cannot establish prospective discovery or a universal transfer law.

planned_state.description: Composition plus processing, phase family, test mode, test temperature and calculated density; all are declared before the YS endpoint.

leakage_controls: Elemental systems remain intact across development and evaluation.
Each target-training donor feature is predicted by a UTS model excluding its held elemental system and every evaluation system.
The final donor model excludes every evaluation elemental system.
The architecture-matched shuffled donor is regenerated inside every source fold and enters the identical target concatenation architecture.
Measured UTS remains a separately labelled auxiliary-measurement ceiling.
ood_definition: Evaluation elemental systems are ranked by median nearest-neighbor composition distance to each actually labelled target-training draw; Q4 is the most distant quarter.

inference.reported_screen_interval: descriptive t interval across the 60 predeclared model-by-draw runs
inference.primary_interval: two-way cluster bootstrap that resamples elemental systems and frozen model-by-draw runs
